BH: B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He
content:
<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos sends every request like a river of light, while Awtsmoos.com must know every bank, bridge, image, poll, cache, and reply in sight; this pass dreams the whole verification universe before Gevurah narrows it right.
-->
# Chesed Brainstorm — Entire Olam Finalization Universe

- Prove Better V2 remains in current main and current production without rolling back later work.
- Enumerate every `/api/olam-h3` route from source.
- Enumerate every browser call site to those routes.
- Trace text-only generation payload construction through browser, server mapper, provider client, task poll, and result extraction.
- Trace first-frame and last-frame semantics.
- Trace image references, video references, and audio references.
- Trace local blob persistence, metadata validation, data-URL conversion, and public URL handling.
- Trace replace/update semantics so a reusable image keeps one identity but gains new bytes everywhere it is referenced.
- Prove stale object URLs cannot survive an in-place blob update.
- Prove add/replace/remove/reorder reference operations cannot duplicate payload entries.
- Prove invalid MIME, size, duration, dimension, and aspect-ratio boundaries.
- Prove the browser never receives provider secrets.
- Prove missing provider credentials produce explicit safe failure, never fake success.
- Prove task identifiers are encoded and routed safely.
- Prove provider error status/message mapping.
- Prove generated result URL extraction and history persistence.
- Run deterministic tests and real Chrome editing flows.
- Run public production UI/API smoke on the current production lineage.
- Verify production Git SHA, clean status, and active service.
- Clean only owned temporary Olam processes/worktrees after evidence closes.
